# PDF dependencies

These pinned browser bundles load only when PDF export is requested.

- [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib), version 1.17.1, MIT license; see `pdf-lib-LICENSE.md`. Bundle: `https://unpkg.com/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.min.js`.
- [@pdf-lib/fontkit](https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit), version 1.1.1, MIT license; see `fontkit-LICENSE.txt`. Bundle: `https://unpkg.com/@pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1/dist/fontkit.umd.min.js`.
